decision.rationale: The disputed charge TXN-007858 (22.72 EUR, Kestrel Athletic Club, on card CRD-000076) was made on 2026-09-25 and posted on 2026-09-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, which is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant-issued cancellation confirmation DOC-000007 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-27. That is after the charge. The charge covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled, so under recurring-cancelled-after-charge the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The Kestrel Athletic Club charge of 22.72 EUR was made on 2026-09-25. Your cancellation confirmation shows the cancellation took effect on 2026-09-27, after that date. The charge covers a period before the cancellation took effect, so it cannot be disputed as a charge made after cancelling.
